entities.summary: Kirkor Kirkorov is a retired Bulgarian boxer who competed for his native country at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain. There he was defeated in the first round of the Men's Featherweight Division by Germany's eventual gold medalist Andreas Tews.
